title: 2.4 Differentiating the Product and the Quotient of Two Functions; Higher-Order Derivatives

icans: I can use the Product Rule.
I can use the Quotient Rule and the Power Rule for negative exponents.
I can find second and higher-order derivatives, including acceleration.

blocks.p: f(x) = x and g(x) = x², so f(x)g(x) = x³.

notes: Higher-order derivatives: f″ is the derivative of f′; if s(t) is position, s″(t) is the _______________.
